mod.title: Rebalanced Spire
others_settings.page.title: Others
map_generation.section.label: Map Generation
map_generation.section.uniform_intro_gen: When enabled, the entrances in each act are distributed more evenly.
map_generation.section.less_continuous_m: When enabled, a route will not contain more than 4 normal enemies in a row.
merchant.section.label: The Merchant
merchant.section.less_price_increase.des: When enabled, at Ascension 6 and above, the price increase for the merchant's card removal service is reduced from 50 to 25.
cards_settings.page.title: Cards
cards_settings.page.description: Includes character-specific cards and colorless cards.
the_ironclad.section.label: The Ironclad
the_ironclad.section.blood_wall.title: Blood Wall
the_ironclad.section.blood_wall.descript: When enabled, Block value is increased from 16 (20) to 18 (22).
the_ironclad.section.expect_a_fight.desc: When enabled, cost is reduced from 2 (1) to 1 (0).
the_ironclad.section.forgotten_ritual.de:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - If you [gold]Exhausted[/gold] a card this turn, gain 3 (4) Energy. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 0 - If you [gold]Exhausted[/gold] a card this turn, gain 3 (4) Energy. Increase this card's cost by 1.
the_silent.section.label: The Silent
the_silent.section.acrobatics.title: Acrobatics
the_silent.section.acrobatics.descriptio: When enabled, rarity is reduced from [gold]Uncommon[/gold] to [gold]Common[/gold].
the_silent.section.blade_of_ink.title: Blade of Ink
the_silent.section.bouncing_flask.title: Bouncing Flask
the_silent.section.bouncing_flask.descri:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 2 - Apply 3 [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy 3 (4) times.
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 2 - [gold]Sly[/gold]. Apply 2 [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy 3 (4) times.
the_silent.section.flick_flack.title: Flick-Flack
the_silent.section.flick_flack.descripti: When enabled, damage is increased from 6 (8) to 7 (9).
the_silent.section.hand_trick.title: Hand Trick
the_silent.section.hand_trick.descriptio:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - Gain 7 (10) [gold]Block[/gold].
Add [gold]Sly[/gold] to a Skill in your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn.
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - Gain 4 (7) [gold]Block[/gold]. Add [gold]Sly[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
the_silent.section.hidden_daggers.title: Hidden Daggers
the_silent.section.hidden_daggers.descri:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 0 - Discard 2 cards. Add 2 [gold]Shivs (Shivs+)[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 0 - Discard 3 (2) cards. Add 2 [purple]Energetic[/purple] [gold]Shivs[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
the_silent.section.infinite_blades.title: Infinite Blades
the_silent.section.infinite_blades.descr:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Uncommon - Cost 1 - At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. (Upgrade grants [gold]Innate[/gold].)
New: Power - Uncommon - Cost 1 - At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. 1 (2) [gold]Shivs[/gold] do not count toward your [gold]Hand Size[/gold]. (Upgrade grants [gold]Innate[/gold].)
the_silent.section.master_planner.title: Master Planner
the_silent.section.master_planner.descri:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Rare - Cost 2 (1) - When you play a Skill, it gains [gold]Sly[/gold].
New: Power - Rare - Cost 2 - Whenever you discard a [gold]Sly[/gold] card, draw 1 (2) cards.
the_silent.section.poisoned_stab.title: Poisoned Stab
the_silent.section.poisoned_stab.descrip:
When enabled:
Old: Attack - Common - Cost 1 - Deal 6 (8) damage. Apply 3 (4) [gold]Poison[/gold].
New: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - Add 2 [purple]Poisonous[/purple] [gold]Shivs (Shivs+)[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
the_silent.section.scare.title: Scare
the_silent.section.scare.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 0 - Apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. (Upgrade removes [gold]Exhaust[/gold].)
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 2 - [gold]Sly[/gold]. Apply 1 (2) [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
the_silent.section.shadowmeld.title: Shadowmeld
the_silent.section.shadowmeld.descriptio:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Rare - Cost 1 (0) - Double your [gold]Block[/gold] gain this turn.
New: Skill - Rare - Cost 1 - [gold]Retain[/gold]. Double your [gold]Block[/gold] gain this turn. [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. (Upgrade removes [gold]Exhaust[/gold].)
the_silent.section.untouchable.title: Untouchable
the_silent.section.untouchable.descripti:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Common - Cost 2 - [gold]Sly[/gold]. Gain 6 (8) [gold]Block[/gold].
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 2 - [gold]Sly[/gold]. Gain 4 (5) [gold]Block[/gold] twice.
the_silent.section.up_my_sleeve.title: Up My Sleeve
the_silent.section.up_my_sleeve.descript:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 2 - Add 3 (4) [gold]Shivs[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Reduce this card's cost by 1.
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 2 - [gold]Sly[/gold]. Add 3 (4) [gold]Shivs[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
the_silent.section.well_laid_plans.title: Well-Laid Plans
the_silent.section.well_laid_plans.descr: When enabled, this card is allowed to appear in multiplayer.
the_regent.section.label: The Regent
the_regent.section.foregone_conclusion.d:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Rare - Cost 1 - Next turn, put 2 (3) cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
New: Power - Rare - Cost 1 (0) - Before your turn starts, put 1 card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
the_regent.section.genesis.title: Genesis
the_regent.section.genesis.description:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Rare - Cost 2 - At the start of your turn, gain 2 (3) Stars.
New: Power - Rare - Cost 2 (1) - At the start of your turn, gain 2 Stars.
the_regent.section.glow.title: Glow
the_regent.section.glow.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - Gain 1 (2) Star(s). Draw 1 card. Next turn, draw 1 card.
New: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - Gain 1 (2) Star(s). Draw 2 cards.
the_regent.section.heirloom_hammer.title: Heirloom Hammer
the_regent.section.heirloom_hammer.descr:
When enabled:
Old: Attack - Rare - Cost 2 - Deal 20 (25) damage. Choose a Colorless card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add a copy of that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
New: Skill - Rare - Cost 1 - [gold]Forge[/gold] 5. Choose a Colorless card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add a (upgraded) copy of that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
the_regent.section.the_sealed_throne.des:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Ancient - Cost 1 (0) - Star Cost 3 - Whenever you play a card, gain 1 Star.
New: Power - Ancient - Cost 1 - Star Cost 3 - Whenever you play a card, gain 1 Star. (Upgrade grants [gold]Innate[/gold].)
the_necrobinder.section.label: The Necrobinder
the_necrobinder.section.afterlife.title: Afterlife
the_necrobinder.section.afterlife.descri:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - [gold]Summon[/gold] 6 (9). [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
New: Power - Uncommon - Cost 1 - At the start of your turn, [gold]Osty[/gold] heals 4 (5) HP. If [gold]Osty[/gold] is dead, [gold]Summon[/gold] 3 (4).
the_necrobinder.section.banshees_cry.des: When enabled, cost is reduced from 9 (7) to 8 (6).
the_necrobinder.section.debilitate.title: Debilitate
the_necrobinder.section.debilitate.descr:
When enabled:
Old: Attack - Uncommon - Cost 1 - Deal 10 (12) damage. [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective against the enemy for the next 2 (3) turns.
New: Attack - Uncommon - Cost 1 - Deal 7 (10) damage. [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective against the enemy for the next 3 (4) turns.
the_necrobinder.section.defy.title: Defy
the_necrobinder.section.defy.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. Gain 6 (9) [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold].
New: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. Gain 6 (7) [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply 1 (2) [gold]Weak[/gold].
the_necrobinder.section.grave_warden.des:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - Gain 8 (11) [gold]Block[/gold]. Add a [gold]Soul[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
New: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - Gain 8 (10) [gold]Block[/gold]. Add a [gold]Soul (Soul+)[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
the_necrobinder.section.pull_aggro.title: Pull Aggro
the_necrobinder.section.pull_aggro.descr:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Common - Cost 2 - [gold]Summon[/gold] 4 (5). Gain 7 (9) [gold]Block[/gold].
New: Skill - Common - Cost 2 - [gold]Summon[/gold] 8 (9). Gain 4 (6) [gold]Block[/gold].
the_necrobinder.section.reaper_form.desc:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Rare - Cost 3 - Whenever Attacks deal damage, apply that much [gold]Doom[/gold].. (Upgrade grants [gold]Retain[/gold].)
New: Power - Rare - Cost 3 - Whenever Attacks deal damage, apply that much [gold]Doom[/gold]. (Upgraded: At the end of your turn, kill enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP.)
When enabled:
Old: Attack - Uncommon - Cost 0 - [gold]Osty[/gold] deals 4 (6) damage. Whenever you play a card costing 2 or more, return this card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
New: Attack - Uncommon - Cost 2 - [gold]Osty[/gold] deals 9 (13) damage. Whenever you play a card costing 2 or more, put this card into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and reduce its cost by 1.
the_necrobinder.section.seance.title: Seance
the_necrobinder.section.seance.descripti:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Rare - Cost 1 (0) - [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. Transform a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into [gold]Soul[/gold].
New: Skill - Rare - Cost 0 - [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. Transform a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into [gold]Soul (Soul+)[/gold].
the_necrobinder.section.sic_em.title: Sic 'Em
the_necrobinder.section.sic_em.descripti:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - [gold]Osty[/gold] deals 5 (6) damage. This turn, whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] hits this enemy, [gold]Summon[/gold] 2 (3).
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - [gold]Osty[/gold] deals 5 (7) damage. Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] hits this enemy, [gold]Summon[/gold] 2 (3). [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
the_necrobinder.section.spur.title: Spur
the_necrobinder.section.spur.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Rare - Cost 1 - [gold]Retain[/gold]. [gold]Summon[/gold] 3 (5). [gold]Osty[/gold] heals 5 (7) HP.
New: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - [gold]Osty[/gold] heals 9 HP. For every 2 excess HP healed, [gold]Summon[/gold] 1 more. (Upgrade grants [gold]Retain[/gold].)
the_necrobinder.section.wisp.title: Wisp
the_necrobinder.section.wisp.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 0 - Gain 1 Energy. [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. (Upgrade grants [gold]Retain[/gold].)
New: Skill - Common - Cost 0 - Gain 1 (2) Energy. Transform a random [gold]Soul[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into [gold]Wisp (Wisp+)[/gold]. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
the_defect.section.label: The Defect
the_defect.section.consuming_shadow.desc:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Rare - Cost 2 - [gold]Channel[/gold] 2 (3) [gold]Dark[/gold] Orbs. At the end of your turn, [gold]Evoke[/gold] your leftmost Orb.
New: Power - Rare - Cost 1 - [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. Record the last [gold]Dark[/gold] Orb you [gold]Evoked[/gold]. Newly channeled [gold]Dark[/gold] Orbs inherit 50% of its damage. (Upgrade removes [gold]Ethereal[/gold].)
the_defect.section.coolant.title: Coolant
the_defect.section.coolant.description: When enabled, Block value is increased from 2 (3) to 3 (4).
the_defect.section.defragment.title: Defragment
the_defect.section.defragment.descriptio: When enabled, rarity is reduced from [gold]Rare[/gold] to [gold]Uncommon[/gold].
the_defect.section.glasswork.title: Glasswork
the_defect.section.glasswork.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - Gain 5 (8) [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold] Orb.
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - Gain 5 (8) [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold] Orb. Increase the damage of all [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs by 2 (3).
the_defect.section.leap.title: Leap
the_defect.section.leap.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - Gain 9 (12) [gold]Block[/gold].
New: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - Gain 9 (12) [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain 1 (2) [gold]Focus[/gold] this turn.
the_defect.section.refract.title: Refract
the_defect.section.refract.description:
When enabled:
Old: Attack - Uncommon - Cost 3 - Deal 9 (12) damage twice. [gold]Channel[/gold] 2 [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs.
New: Skill - Common - Cost 1 - [gold]Channel[/gold] 2 [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs. [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. (Upgrade removes [gold]Exhaust[/gold].)
the_defect.section.spinner.title: Spinner
the_defect.section.spinner.description:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Rare - Cost 1 - At the start of your turn, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold] Orb. (Upgrade [gold]Channels[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold] Orb.)
New: Power - Rare - Cost 1 - At the start of your turn, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 (2) [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs, and trigger the passive ability of all [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs.
the_defect.section.synchronize.title: Synchronize
the_defect.section.synchronize.descripti:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Uncommon - Cost 1 - For each unique Orb you have, gain 2 [gold]Focus[/gold] this turn. [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. (Upgrade removes [gold]Exhaust[/gold].)
New: Power - Rare - Cost 2 (1) - Record newly [gold]Channeled[/gold] Orbs. The first time you record a new type of Orb, gain 1 [gold]Focus[/gold].
the_defect.section.voltaic.title: Voltaic
the_defect.section.voltaic.description:
When enabled:
Old: Skill - Rare - Cost 3 - [gold]Channel[/gold] [gold]Lightning[/gold] Orbs equal to the number of [gold]Lightning[/gold] Orbs already [gold]Channeled[/gold] this combat. [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. (Upgrade removes [gold]Exhaust[/gold].)
New: Skill - Rare - Cost 3 (2) - [gold]Channel[/gold] [gold]Lightning[/gold] Orbs equal to the number of [gold]Lightning[/gold] Orbs already [gold]Channeled[/gold] this combat.
the_colorless.section.label: Colorless Cards
the_colorless.section.bolas.title: Bolas
the_colorless.section.bolas.description:
When enabled:
Old: Attack - Rare - Cost 0 - Deal 3 (4) damage. At the start of your next turn, return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
New: Attack - Rare - Cost 0 - Deal 3 (4) damage. At the start of your next turn, return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold], and increase its attack damage by 3 (4).
the_colorless.section.eternal_armor.desc:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Rare - Cost 3 - Gain 9 (12) [gold]Plating[/gold].
New: Power - Rare - Cost 3 - Gain 11 [gold]Plating[/gold]. [gold]Plating[/gold] no longer decreases. (Upgrade grants [gold]Retain[/gold].)
the_colorless.section.rolling_boulder.de:
When enabled:
Old: Power - Rare - Cost 3 - At the start of your turn, deal 5 (10) damage to ALL enemies, then increase this damage by 5.
New: Power - Rare - Cost 3 - At the start of your turn, deal 10 (15) damage to ALL enemies, then increase this damage by 10.
relics_settings.page.title: Relics
neow.section.label: Neow
neow.section.booming_conch.title: Booming Conch
neow.section.booming_conch.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - At the start of [gold]Elite[/gold] combats, draw [blue]2[/blue] additional cards and gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy.
New: Ancient - In combats against [gold]Elite[/gold] enemies, the first [blue]3[/blue] cards you play are free.
neow.section.fishing_rod.title: Fishing Rod
neow.section.fishing_rod.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Every [blue]3[/blue] normal combats, randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
New: Ancient - Every [blue]3[/blue] combat victories, randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow.section.large_capsule.title: Large Capsule
neow.section.large_capsule.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, obtain [blue]2[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold]. Add an additional [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, obtain a random [gold]Uncommon[/gold] Relic and a random [gold]Rare[/gold] Relic, and add a [red]Writhe[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow.section.lava_rock.title: Lava Rock
neow.section.lava_rock.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - The Act 1 Boss enemy drops [blue]2[/blue] additional [gold]Relics[/gold].
New: Ancient - Every time you defeat [blue]4[/blue] enemies, enemies drop an additional [gold]Uncommon[/gold] card reward, and the total number of enemies required increases by [blue]1[/blue].
neow.section.neows_lament.title: Neow's Lament
neow.section.neows_lament.description:
When enabled, adds [gold]Neow's Lament[/gold] to [gold]Neow[/gold]'s Ancient Relics. Mutually exclusive with [gold]Winged Boots[/gold].
[gold]Neow's Lament[/gold]: Ancient - Enemies in the next [blue]3[/blue] combats will have only [blue]1[/blue] HP.
neow.section.neows_talisman.title: Neow's Talisman
neow.section.neows_talisman.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold].
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] one of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and one of your [gold]Defends[/gold], then randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card.
neow.section.nutritious_oyster.title: Nutritious Oyster
neow.section.nutritious_oyster.descripti:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]11[/blue].
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]11[/blue]. At the end of combat, heal [green]1[/green] HP.
neow.section.pomander.title: Pomander
neow.section.pomander.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card.
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card, then randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card.
neow.section.neow_ancient_choices.title: Ancient Relic Choices
neow.section.neow_ancient_choices.descri: When enabled, modifies [gold]Neow[/gold]'s Ancient Relic choices: allows [gold]Lava Rock[/gold] and [gold]Small Capsule[/gold] to appear together.
orobas.section.label: Orobas
orobas.section.alchemical_coffer.title: Alchemical Coffer
orobas.section.alchemical_coffer.descrip:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, gain [blue]4[/blue] potion slots filled with random potions.
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, gain [blue]1[/blue] potion slot filled with a random potion, and start tracking your last used potion. At the end of combat, gain an additional copy of that potion.
orobas.section.orobas_ancient_choices.de: When enabled, modifies [gold]Orobas[/gold]'s Ancient Relic choices: swaps the positions of [gold]Electric Shrymp[/gold] and [gold]Driftwood[/gold], and changes the appearance rates of [gold]Prismatic Gem[/gold] and [gold]Sea Glass[/gold] to 50%.
pael.section.label: Pael
pael.section.paels_horn.title: Pael's Horn
pael.section.paels_horn.description:
When enabled: Upon pickup, add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Relax[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
[gold]Relax[/gold]:
 - Old: Skill - Ancient - Cost 3 - Gain 15 (17) [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, draw 2 (3) cards and gain 2 (3) Energy. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
 - New: Skill - Ancient - Cost 3 - Gain 20 (23) [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, draw 2 (3) cards and gain 3 Energy. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
tezcatara.section.label: Tezcatara
tezcatara.section.biiig_hug.title: Biiig Hug
tezcatara.section.biiig_hug.description:
When enabled: Upon pickup, remove [blue]4[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], add a [gold]Soot[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
[gold]Soot[/gold]:
 - Old: Status - [gold]Unplayable[/gold].
 - New: Status - Cost 1 - [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
tezcatara.section.seal_of_gold.title: Seal of Gold
tezcatara.section.seal_of_gold.descripti:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - At the start of your turn, spend [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy.
New: Ancient - On the first right-click each turn, spend [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy.
tezcatara.section.toasty_mittens.title: Toasty Mittens
tezcatara.section.toasty_mittens.descrip:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - At the start of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
New: Ancient - At the start of your turn, choose [blue]1[/blue] of the bottom [blue]5[/blue] cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to [gold]Exhaust[/gold], and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
darv.section.label: Darv
darv.section.dusty_tome.title: Dusty Tome
darv.section.dusty_tome.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, obtain an [gold]Ancient Card[/gold].
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] upgraded [gold]Ancient Cards[/gold] to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
darv.section.darv_ancient_choices.title: Ancient Relic Choices
darv.section.darv_ancient_choices.descri: When enabled, modifies [gold]Darv[/gold]'s Ancient Relic choices: [gold]Dusty Tome[/gold] is guaranteed to appear in the third option.
nonupeipe.section.label: Nonupeipe
nonupeipe.section.looming_fruit.title: Looming Fruit
nonupeipe.section.looming_fruit.descript:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]31[/blue].
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]31[/blue]. Whenever you obtain a relic reward, also gain a random fruit [gold]Relic[/gold].
tanx.section.label: Tanx
tanx.section.crossbow.title: Crossbow
tanx.section.crossbow.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]Attack[/gold] card to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It is free to play this turn.
New: Ancient - At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]Attack[/gold] card to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It is free to play this combat, but [gold]Exhausts[/gold] when played.
tanx.section.war_hammer.title: War Hammer
tanx.section.war_hammer.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Whenever you defeat an [gold]Elite[/gold] enemy, randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]4[/blue] cards.
New: Ancient - For each [gold]non-Minion[/gold] enemy that dies, randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card at the end of combat.
vakuu.section.label: Vakuu
vakuu.section.blood_soaked_rose.title: Blood-Soaked Rose
vakuu.section.blood_soaked_rose.descript:
When enabled: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Enthralled[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy at the start of your turn.
[gold]Enthralled[/gold]:
 - Old: Curse - Cost 2 - If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], you must play it before other cards. [gold]Eternal[/gold].
 - New: Curse - Cost 1 - [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], you must play it before other cards. [gold]Eternal[/gold].
vakuu.section.choices_paradox.title: Choices Paradox
vakuu.section.choices_paradox.descriptio:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]5[/blue] random cards into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add [gold]Retain[/gold] to the chosen card.
New: Ancient - At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Upgraded[/gold] random cards into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add [gold]Retain[/gold] to the chosen card.
vakuu.section.fiddle.title: Fiddle
vakuu.section.fiddle.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - At the start of each turn, draw [blue]2[/blue] additional cards. You can no longer draw cards during your turn.
New: Ancient - At the start of each turn, draw [blue]2[/blue] additional cards. Your max hand size is reduced by [red]2[/red].
vakuu.section.preserved_fog.title: Preserved Fog
vakuu.section.preserved_fog.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, remove [blue]3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, remove [blue]5[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
[gold]Folly[/gold]:
 - Old: Curse - [gold]Unplayable[/gold]. [gold]Innate[/gold]. [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. [gold]Eternal[/gold].
 - New: Curse - [gold]Unplayable[/gold]. [gold]Innate[/gold]. [gold]Eternal[/gold].
vakuu.section.sere_talon.title: Sere Talon
vakuu.section.sere_talon.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - Upon pickup, add [blue]2[/blue] random [red]Curse[/red] cards and [blue]3[/blue] [purple]Wishes[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
New: Ancient - Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Writhe[/red] and [blue]2[/blue] [purple]Wishes[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
[gold]Wish[/gold]:
 - Old: Skill - Ancient - Cost 0 - Put a card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
 - New: Skill - Ancient - Cost 0 - Put a card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
vakuu.section.lords_parasol.title: Lord's Parasol
vakuu.section.lords_parasol.description:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - When you encounter the [gold]Merchant[/gold], immediately obtain [red]all[/red] items he sells.
New: Ancient - At the start of each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy. When you encounter the [gold]Merchant[/gold], immediately obtain [red]all[/red] items he sells.
vakuu.section.whispering_earring.title: Whispering Earring
vakuu.section.whispering_earring.descrip:
When enabled:
Old: Ancient - At the start of each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy. [red]Vakuu will take over your first turn.[/red]
New: Ancient - At the start of each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy. The first time you spend a total of [blue]13[/blue] Energy in combat, [red]Vakuu will take over your current turn.[/red]
vakuu.section.vakuu_ancient_choices.desc: When enabled, modifies [gold]Vakuu[/gold]'s Ancient Relic choices: [gold]Fiddle[/gold] appears in option one, and [gold]Lord's Parasol[/gold] appears in option two.
vakuu.section.vakuu_fixed_art.title: Vakuu Fixed Art
vakuu.section.vakuu_fixed_art.descriptio: When enabled, uses [gold]Vakuu[/gold]'s fixed art assets, provided by [gold]Bilibili Uploader VicoRチャンネル[/gold].
events_settings.page.title: Events
events_settings.page.description: Includes events from Overgrowth, Underdocks, Hive, and Glory.
overgrowth.section.label: Overgrowth
overgrowth.section.morphic_grove.title: Morphic Grove
overgrowth.section.morphic_grove.descrip:
When enabled, modifies the effect of the [gold]Group[/gold] option.
Old: Lose [red]all[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] cards.
New: Lose [red]99[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] cards.
underdocks.section.label: Underdocks
underdocks.section.punch_off.title: Punch Off
underdocks.section.punch_off.description:
When enabled, modifies the effect of the [gold]I Can Take Them[/gold] option.
Old: Two [gold]Punch Constructs[/gold] start with 2–10 HP missing.
New: Two [gold]Punch Constructs[/gold] start with 70–80% of their Max HP and gain special intents.
underdocks.section.spiraling_whirlpool.d: When enabled, adds a new [gold]Reach In[/gold] option: Obtain a random Rare [gold]Relic[/gold]. Add an [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
act1.section.label: Act 1
act1.section.sunken_statue.title: Sunken Statue
act1.section.sunken_statue.description:
When enabled, modifies the effect of the [gold]Pick Up the Stone Sword[/gold] option.
[gold]Stone Sword[/gold]:
 - Old: After defeating [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] enemies, it will transform into a powerful [gold]Relic[/gold].
 - New: After defeating [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] enemies, it will transform into a powerful [gold]Relic[/gold].
[gold]Jade Sword[/gold]:
 - Old: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
 - New: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
hive.section.label: Hive
hive.section.lost_wisp.title: Lost Wisp
hive.section.lost_wisp.description:
When enabled, modifies the effect of the [gold]Capture the Wisp[/gold] option.
Old: Add a [red]Decay[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Obtain [gold]Lost Wisp[/gold].
New: Take [red]8[/red] damage. Obtain [gold]Lost Wisp[/gold].
hive.section.spirit_grafter.title: Spirit Grafter
hive.section.spirit_grafter.description: When enabled, adds a new [gold]Strike Back[/gold] option: [gold]Remove[/gold] an [gold]Attack[/gold] card from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
hive.section.welcome_to_wongos.title: Welcome to Wongo's
hive.section.welcome_to_wongos.descripti: When enabled, adds a new [gold]Leave[/gold] option: Take [red]3[/red] damage.
hive.section.the_lantern_key.title: Lantern Key
hive.section.the_lantern_key.description: When enabled, modifies the [gold]Leave the Key[/gold] option: reduces the difficulty of the [gold]Mysterious Knight[/gold] fight.
act1and2.section.label: Acts 1 and 2
act1and2.section.tea_master.title: Tea Master
act1and2.section.tea_master.description:
When enabled:
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Bone Tea[/gold] option.
 - Old: Pay [red]50[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. At the start of your next [blue]1[/blue] combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] your starting hand.
 - New: Pay [red]50[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Obtain [blue]1[/blue] bottle of [gold]Bone Tea[/gold] ([gold]Upgrade[/gold] all cards in your Draw Pile).
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Ember Tea[/gold] option.
 - Old: Pay [red]150[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. At the start of the next [blue]5[/blue] combats, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
 - New: Pay [red]150[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Obtain [blue]2[/blue] bottles of [gold]Ember Tea[/gold] (Gain 5 Strength).
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Tea of Discourtesy[/gold] option.
 - Old: At the start of the next combat, put [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
 - New: Obtain [blue]1[/blue] bottle of [gold]Tea of Discourtesy[/gold] (Put 2 Dazed into your Discard Pile. Can also be thrown at the Merchant to randomly Upgrade cards).
glory.section.label: Glory
glory.section.hungry_for_mushrooms.title: Hungry for Mushrooms
glory.section.hungry_for_mushrooms.descr:
When enabled:
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Big Mushroom[/gold] option.
 - Old: Obtain [gold]Big Mushroom[/gold]. On pickup, increase your Max HP by [blue]20[/blue]. At the start of each combat, draw [blue]2[/blue] fewer cards.
 - New: Obtain [gold]Big Mushroom[/gold]. On pickup, increase your Max HP by [blue]25[/blue]. At the start of each combat, draw [blue]1[/blue] fewer card.
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Aromatic Mushroom[/gold] option.
 - Old: Obtain [gold]Aromatic Mushroom[/gold]. On pickup, lose [red]15[/red] HP, then randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] cards.
 - New: Obtain [gold]Aromatic Mushroom[/gold]. On pickup, lose [red]15[/red] HP, then randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] cards.
glory.section.reflections.title: Reflections
glory.section.reflections.description:
When enabled:
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Touch a Mirror[/gold] option.
 - Old: [red]Downgrade[/red] [blue]2[/blue] random cards. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]4[/blue] random cards.
 - New: [red]Downgrade[/red] [blue]1[/blue] card. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] random cards.
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Shatter[/gold] option.
 - Old: Duplicate your entire [gold]Deck[/gold]. Receive [purple]Bad Luck[/purple].
 - New: Duplicate your entire [gold]Deck[/gold].
Adds a new [gold]Stare[/gold] option: Choose at most [blue]13[/blue] cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] to duplicate. Receive [purple]Bad Luck[/purple].
glory.section.trial.title: Trial
glory.section.trial.description:
When enabled:
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Innocent[/gold] option in the Merchant case.
 - Old: Obtain [gold]Shame[/gold], and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] cards in your Deck.
 - New: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card.
Modifies the effect of the [gold]Innocent[/gold] option in the Nondescript Woman case.
 - Old: Obtain [gold]Doubt[/gold], and [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] cards in your Deck.
 - New: [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card.
